message:
We were all set for a family picnic last weekend — the perfect day, the perfect spread. Just as we were about to take the group photo, my phone decided it was the perfect moment to die. No warning, no battery left to capture those smiles. 

It really hit home how much we rely on our devices, not just for fun but for staying connected and prepared. We laughed it off, but it reminded us that having a backup plan is key. Maybe next time, we’ll bring a good old-fashioned camera along, just in case. 📸
